title: National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non-Communicable Diseases (NP-NCD; formerly NPCDCS) Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non-Communicable Diseases (NP-NCD; formerly NPCDCS)
Jurisdiction: India
Category: Screening and chronic disease services
Type: Public Healthcare Service
Details: Public health programme supporting prevention, screening, early diagnosis and management of major non-communicable diseases.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: People accessing participating public facilities; screening follows programme protocols and age/risk criteria.
Individual Enrolment Required: False

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Identity details and available prior medical records; requirements vary by facility.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Visit a participating Ayushman Arogya Mandir, PHC, CHC or designated government facility.
Official Portal: https://nhm.gov.in/
